overall: The AG found the Provincetown Board of Selectmen violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to respond within 14 business days to two August 2013 complaints, ordered future compliance, and closed the matter with no further relief.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to respond timely to two Open Meeting Law complaints he filed with it on August 12, 2013.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to respond within 14 business-days of receipt of the August 12, 2013 complaints.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
Caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law (no additional relief ordered)
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
